summary: All endpoints move from /v1/... to /v2/... and FleetSnapshot.api_version changes from v1 to v2; v1 is deprecated and will be shut off on 2026-12-01. Orientation changes from Euler degrees (roll/pitch/yaw, intrinsic Z-Y-X) to unit quaternion orientation.qx,qy,qz,qw (Hamilton convention, scalar last) for the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) with sign not canonicalised. Scalar noise (isotropic 1-sigma, metres) is replaced by 6x6 row-major covariance (x,y,z m then rotation about X,Y,Z rad) and new required health (0..1, alert below 0.5) is added.

fields_removed.notes: Removed isotropic 1-sigma position uncertainty, metres. Replaced by covariance. Migration: anything that weighted by 1 / noise2 should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block. Scalar equivalent sigma = sqrt(trace(P_pos)/3) where P_pos = covariance[0:3][0:3] in m2.

Removed degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X. Replaced by unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). Server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. Migration: build rotations from the quaternion directly; do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.

Removed degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X. Replaced by unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). Server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. Migration: build rotations from the quaternion directly; do not round-trip through Euler for tilt. If you still need heading, use yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy2 + qz2)).

fields_added.notes: Added 6x6 symmetric pose covariance as nested row-major arrays. Variable order x, y, z (m) then rotation about X, Y, Z (rad). The position block covariance[0:3][0:3] is in m2. Migration: anything that weighted by 1 / noise2 should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block. Scalar equivalent sigma = sqrt(trace(P_pos)/3).

Added required health (0..1): composite localisation/drive health from the on-robot monitor. 1 = nominal; values below 0.5 mean the robot should be serviced. Ops dashboards should raise a health alert below 0.5.

type_changes.notes: Changed from EulerOrientation (degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X) to Quaternion (unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last) describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). Server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. Rationale: Euler angles hit gimbal lock at pitch ≈ ±90 degrees.
